title: Operations Director
text:
**Full-Time • Proposed**

The Operations Director will be a key leadership position at Garden Gate Ranch, bringing structure, strength, consistency, and operational excellence to the organization as it grows.

This role is designed for a highly organized, relational, systems-minded leader who loves building healthy organizational infrastructure, developing people, and translating vision into execution.

The Operations Director will serve as the operational integrator of Garden Gate Ranch—ensuring that the right systems, people, processes, and resources are in place so the organization can carry out its mission effectively and sustainably.

**Join us in creating a safe, Christ-centered environment where women can heal, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $53,800.00 - $64,900.00 per year

Work Location: In person
